### Brooke Slade
<p class="role">PhD Student</p>

::: {.contact}

:::
After completing her undergraduate studies at Florida State University, Brooke earned a master’s degree in Medical Biology at the University of Salzburg, Austria. Her PhD project explores the therapeutic potential of implantable materials in the peritoneal cavity, investigating how the foreign body reaction can be attenuated or modulated to extend the functional lifetime of biomaterials.
